Turn mathematical expressions into something beautiful with Python.

With SymPy, you can expand and factor algebraic expressions, work with symbolic mathematics, and simplify trigonometric identities—all with just a few lines of code.

For example:

Expand algebraic expressions

Factor mathematical formulas
